fullPassage: Perhaps the most widespread stress from technology that most people experience is the perpetual distraction of email and the replacement of face-to-face conversation with digital communications. In one of a series of articles in 2010 for the New York Times, technology investigative reporter Matt Richtel noted that people check email up to 37 times an hour on average. Furthermore, some people feel an urge to respond to emails immediately and feel guilty if they don't. Incoming emails can be filtered depending on their importance to you and your work. How many emails can push one over the edge, past the threshold of exhaustion? According to a Harris Interactive poll, respondents said that more than 50 emails per day caused stress, many using the phrase "email stress" to explain their frustrations.

det.tip: urge = a strong desire or impulse. feel an urge to ~ = ~하고 싶은 충동을 느끼다.

questions.passage: Perhaps the most widespread stress from technology that most people experience is the perpetual distraction of email and the replacement of __________ with digital communications. In one of a series of articles in 2010 for the New York Times, technology investigative reporter Matt Richtel noted that people check email up to 37 times an hour on average. Furthermore, some people feel an urge to respond to emails immediately and feel guilty if they don't. Incoming emails can be filtered depending on their importance to you and your work. How many emails can push one over the edge, past the threshold of exhaustion? According to a Harris Interactive poll, respondents said that more than 50 emails per day caused stress, many using the phrase "email stress" to explain their frustrations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: face-to-face conversation(대면 대화) — 기술 스트레스의 하나로 이메일이 대면 대화를 대체하고 있다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① social media interaction: 소셜 미디어 상호작용, 본문에 언급되지 않은 구체적 수단
❌ ② digital communication skill: 디지털 소통 기술, digital communications가 대체하는 대상이므로 반대 방향
✅ ③ face-to-face conversation: 원문 일치 — 대면 대화가 디지털 소통으로 대체됨
❌ ④ online group discussion: 온라인 그룹 토론, 본문에 언급되지 않은 개념
det.tip: the replacement of face-to-face conversation with digital communications — 대면 대화가 디지털 소통으로 대체됨.

det.korean: push one over the edge(~를 한계로 몰다) — 얼마나 많은 이메일이 사람을 탈진의 한계점 너머로 밀어붙일 수 있는가라는 수사 의문문
